_comment: Goldens for the isolated SHARC handler harness (agree-subtract-compare). effects lists contain postA==postB!=baseline entries as addr:base->injected. Frames and PC samples are never compared: sub-frame handlers are invisible to per-frame PC polling.

00._comment: add service with 1.0, 2.0: result leaves via the output FIFO (not DM), so the DM effect set is empty; outcome proves inject->dispatch->handler->idle

fd._comment: output-FIFO drain after the 00 trial: must contain 3.0 (1.0+2.0), proving the add handler really executed and was not just idle persistence; only judged when the preceding trial is 00

03._comment: division service with 1.0, 2.0: result leaves via the output FIFO (not DM), so the DM effect set is empty; judged only under a spec that feeds it two args

08._comment: service-state init: effect set pinned after first validated run
